findings:
IMPLEMENTED the .NET rewire + removal of the patched-from-source Discord.Net voice apparatus.

== CHANGES ==
- BotOptions.cs: added `SidecarBaseUrl` (default "http://jaina-voice-sidecar:8080") and `SidecarToken` (default ""). Bound from Bot:SidecarBaseUrl / Bot:SidecarToken (env Bot__SidecarBaseUrl / Bot__SidecarToken). All other options untouched.
- Program.cs: added AddHttpClient("voice-sidecar", ...) immediately after the existing "gemini" block: sets BaseAddress = opts.SidecarBaseUrl, Timeout = 120s, and adds header X-Sidecar-Token (TryAddWithoutValidation, trimmed) only when SidecarToken is non-empty. Mirrors the gemini pattern (IOptions<BotOptions> resolved from sp).
- Worker.cs: (1) removed `EnableVoiceDaveEncryption = true` + its comment from the DiscordSocketConfig initializer (GatewayIntents unchanged: AllUnprivileged | MessageContent). (2) In RunAskJainaAsync the static-clip branch now calls `await PlayViaSidecarAsync(command.GuildId!.Value, voiceChannel.Id, wav);` instead of `new VoicePlayback(...).PlayWavAsync(...)`; the commented Gemini block was updated identically so re-enabling AI only changes which `wav` bytes are passed. Both ModifyOriginalResponseAsync calls kept ("Here is Jaina." on success; the catch failure message). (3) Added private helper PlayViaSidecarAsync(ulong guildId, ulong channelId, byte[] wav): CreateClient("voice-sidecar"), POSTs ByteArrayContent with Content-Type audio/wav to `/play?guildId={guildId}&channelId={channelId}` threading _stoppingToken, then EnsureSuccessStatusCode() so failures hit the existing catch. Added `using System.Net.Http.Headers;` for MediaTypeHeaderValue. Worker.cs never imported Discord.Audio (that was VoicePlayback.cs), so no using removal was needed there.
- Deleted JainaProudmoore/VoicePlayback.cs entirely.
- Deleted JainaProudmoore/patches/ entirely (dave-pr-3288.patch, dave-finishconnectaudio-guard.patch, NuGet.config, README.md, .gitattributes).
- Dockerfile: removed the entire DAVE-PR-3288 `discordnet` from-source Discord.Net build stage; removed the build-stage `COPY --from=discordnet /packages/ ./local-packages/` and `COPY patches/NuGet.config ./NuGet.config` lines; removed from the base stage the libopus0/libsodium install + unversioned-symlink loop, the libdave fetch (ARG LIBDAVE_*, curl/unzip download/extract/licenses) and ffmpeg. Base stage now only installs ca-certificates (TLS) and keeps USER $APP_UID. App stays on stock Discord.Net 3.20.2 from nuget.org (PackageReference unchanged).

== /play CLIENT CONTRACT (what the bot now sends) ==
POST {SidecarBaseUrl}/play?guildId=<ulong>&channelId=<ulong>, body = raw WAV bytes, Content-Type: audio/wav, optional header X-Sidecar-Token (sent only when Bot:SidecarToken is set). Client HttpClient timeout 120s. guildId = command.GuildId!.Value (slash command is guild-gated earlier in HandleSlashCommand), channelId = the caller's current voice channel Id. Non-2xx => EnsureSuccessStatusCode throws => caught by RunAskJainaAsync catch => user sees "Jaina couldn't answer that right now." This matches FEAT-001's sidecar: 200 ok; 400 bad/missing ids or empty body; 401 bad/missing token; 413 too large; 422 DAVE-not-ready; 502 join/transcode/play; 504 playback timeout.
